source_provenance_boundary: SHA-256 values identify retained navigation snapshots and result/log files. These exploratory builds did not retain a complete per-run compiled-source/executable hash manifest; the snapshots are not cryptographic proof of each executed binary. Final main-workspace build provenance is recorded separately.
failure_reporting_boundary: A parsed matrix with completed=false is retained as a failed simulation, including its actual fault and measured partial metrics. Failed compilation or interrupted shell attempts are not counted as completed simulation evidence.
unchanged_constraints: No Q/R changes, expanded node/terminal budgets, new controller, shrunken footprint/margins, relaxed stopping/arrival/deadlines or delay-array-specific production branches.
Every warm/rebased result remains subject to the shared finite solver ledger and full current geometry/error checks.
